title: anticipation
original_title: Under the Grates: Waiting at the Door
emotion: Blim's suspended curiosity before entering the unknown.
caption: BEFORE THE FIRST STEP

title: dismay
emotion: An ordinary walk breaks into shock, disorientation and fragile survival.
caption: THE GROUND GIVES WAY

title: vulnerability
emotion: Small and alone, Blim learns to trust a path revealed by a fading light.
caption: ONE LIGHT IN ALL THIS DARK

title: delight
emotion: A small, useful discovery brings a moment of satisfaction rather than victory.
caption: SOMETHING WORTH KEEPING

title: curiosity
emotion: Wrappers, arrows and a recorded voice make Blim wonder who travelled here first.
caption: A VOICE BEYOND THE TURN

title: determination
emotion: Repeated effort and wrong turns become Blim's decision to continue upward.
caption: ONE MORE REACH

title: loss
emotion: The waiting headlamp makes an unreturned promise real to Blim.
caption: SOMETHING LEFT WAITING

title: courage
emotion: The earlier upgrade sketch imagines a little more confidence, not complete safety.
caption: A LITTLE MORE LIGHT
usage_note: Legacy proposal retained as its own cue; loss is the current C-19 cinematic score.

title: resilience
emotion: Against moving water and machinery, Blim's persistence grows quieter rather than louder.
caption: THE CURRENT DOES NOT CHOOSE

title: hope
emotion: Roots, fresh air and light turn the possibility of escape into something tangible.
caption: THERE IS AIR ABOVE

title: relief
emotion: Blim reaches ordinary daylight and completes a climb the unseen Guide could not.
caption: THE WORLD KEPT TURNING

title: perseverance
emotion: Blim carries uncertainty, human traces and loss through the whole journey toward daylight.
caption: CARRY THE LIGHT FORWARD

title: serenity
emotion: The same journey is held in stillness, with space to rest between small gestures.
caption: NOTHING NEEDS TO HURRY

title: euphoria
emotion: Buoyant dance-floor energy; independent of the game story.
caption: LIGHT WITHOUT A CEILING
